ledger_entries.claim: The final #170336 merge changes only five test/support files (+496/-38), with no production repair. In-process cold-state reconstruction disposes old SQLite handles and rotates lifecycle generation. Eleven source scenarios cover native/Control UI, missing/delegated/cron, exact agent/session/incarnation/lifecycle claims and post-admission device/role invalidation. Allowed paths persist one disabled job through the actual automation/Gateway/Cron owner; refused paths assert no jobs. Built-in/catalog preparation tests separately assert attribution invalidation before prepare/execute.
ledger_entries.validation_limits: Turn service, model preflight, factory collaborators and native handshake material are synthetic or mocked. No OS process kill, signed native handshake, live inference or external automation execution. A disabled durable job is not exactly-once remote-effect proof. Author counts and mutation-check results are unaudited; CI metadata only. Earlier production and 232-test comments concern old heads, not the final test-only diff.
ledger_entries.test_source_scope: All five immutable merge patches fully read. Includes actual device-revocation/role-state owners under a synthetic fixture, stronger source assertions than #173579 read-only session mode. We do not claim runtime revocation validation.

ledger_entries.published_at_kind: PR merged_at; older proposal/CI dates recorded separately
ledger_entries.ci_boundary: Run metadata only; no job logs or test execution independently audited.
ledger_entries.claim: A synchronous lifecycle callback identifies cancellation before the current client writes thread state while waiting for predecessor physical exit. Startup preserves a healthy replacement only at that boundary; the successor still waits for physical exit before native resume. Timeout retirement and configured-MCP post-thread/start cleanup retain conservative behavior.
ledger_entries.validation_limits: All six merge patches read. Committed tests use deterministic synthetic client/transport/lease fixtures. The maintainer native Codex 0.161.0 base/head trace is an attributed excerpt; the temporary harness is not committed and we performed no independent run or artifact audit. The 03:58:21 contributor comment notes one Docker failure attributed to base and a local autoreview authentication failure. Prepared-head main CI success is metadata, not independent proof that every test passed.
ledger_entries.test_source_scope: Two test patches and four production patches fully read, covering cancellation preservation, unchanged timeout retirement and post-write exclusion assertions. Native proof claims do not replace the committed regression or our own execution.
